method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: US Stocks Fall as Oil, Yields Climb While Walmart Slumps
Equities.reason: Market-regime headline: links rising yields and oil to broad equity weakness while citing a major retailer slump. Signals a liquidity/yield-driven risk-off impulse across US equities rather than idiosyncratic stock news.

Equities.title: Equities: Mixed recovery after US selloff – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists note that United States (US) equities fell sharply as earlier gains in fixed income reversed, with losses across the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Magnificent Seven. Weak Walmart earnings and slower US sales growth added to concerns about c
Equities.reason: Selloff framing from a major strategist: ties equity weakness to a reversal in fixed income and disappointing consumer/retail datapoints (Walmart), reinforcing a yields/liquidity-driven negative equity narrative.

Equities.title: Dow, Nasdaq close sharply lower as Treasury buybacks fail to calm bond market
Equities.reason: Direct cross-market transmission: ties equity declines to persistent bond-market stress and failed Treasury operations, highlighting macro/liquidity pressures that amplify equity downside.

Equities.title: Walmart stock tumbles 9% after outlook disappoints Wall Street
Equities.summary: Walmart is expected to report its fiscal second-quarter earnings on Thursday, offering a read on the consumer and the K-shaped economy.
Equities.reason: Large-cap retail miss and outlook disappointment feeding into market risk sentiment. While single-stock, Walmart's size and consumer read make this a relevant negative signal for cyclical/consumer exposure.

Equities.title: So much for the Bessent bid
Equities.reason: Market commentary referencing the fading 'Bessent put' — a narrative that relief from bond-market pain is disappearing. Reinforces the dominant theme that bond/liquidity dynamics are pressuring equities.

Rates.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent doubles US long-bond buybacks in the face of surging yields
Rates.reason: Large, explicit Treasury buyback program is bond-supportive (should help lower long-term yields). High relevance because it is a direct market intervention by the Treasury, though market skepticism limits the upside for bonds.

Rates.title: U.S. Stocks and Bonds Slide, Brushing Off Treasury’s Buyback Plans
Rates.reason: Market reaction indicates buybacks failed to stop a bond selloff — clear signal of rising yields and weaker bond prices. High relevance as it shows intervention being ineffective and the prevailing market impulse (yields up).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes showing growing urgency around policy tightening/raising rates is directly negative for bond prices (pushes yields higher). Very relevant for the rates market and supports the higher-for-longer yields narrative.

Rates.title: What is Bessent doing — and will it work?
Rates.summary: US Treasury secretary has made a high-stakes bet he can beat back soaring borrowing costs
Rates.reason: FT analysis is skeptical about the effectiveness of buybacks and frames the move as unlikely to fully resolve upward pressure on yields — negative for bonds with moderate-high relevance.

Rates.title: Bessent's efforts in the Treasury market so far haven't worked. Here's what else he can try
Rates.summary: Market experts showed skepticism at whether the push would succeed against a bevy of factors working against Treasurys.
Rates.reason: Market skepticism about Treasury buybacks' ability to curb yields reinforces ongoing selloff pressure — negative for bond prices with moderate relevance.

Rates.title: How the A.I. Borrowing Binge Helps Drive Up Government Bond Yields
Rates.reason: Increased corporate/tech issuance linked to AI financing raises supply pressure in government bond markets (upward pressure on yields). Relevant as a structural supply-side driver of higher yields.

Rates.title: Warsh faces Fed independence test as Bessent moves in on central bank's turf
Rates.summary: Bessent’s effort to tamp down long-term Treasury yields could force Warsh to clarify how far the Fed should go in coordinating on bonds and the balance sheet.
Rates.reason: Highlights potential for coordination/intervention that could help long-end yields if acted on — but institutional/timing uncertainty keeps relevance low and net effect small.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Backstop doubts and high intervention bar – BNY
Rates.summary: BNY’s David Tam stresses that while the Federal Reserve retains legal capacity to support corporate credit, the current Warsh Fed is unlikely to repeat Covid‑era interventions.
Rates.reason: Signals that Fed is less likely to provide aggressive market backstops, reducing potential support for bond prices and increasing vulnerability to higher yields; directly relevant to intervention/backstop narrative.

FX.title: Euro: Gentle upside against US Dollar as greenback softens - ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner says EUR/USD remains well supported by broad Dollar softness. Expected mild eurozone growth in the August PMIs and elevated inflation expectations keep the case for another European Central Bank (ECB) hike alive.
FX.reason: FX-native: signals broad USD softness and euro upside on ECB hike potential and PMIs. Contributes to a USD-weak / EUR-strong intraday regime.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: September BoJ risk builds – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank argues that July inflation and strong Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data in Japan suggest price dynamics would not block a Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate hike.
FX.reason: BoJ hike risk = JPY tightening / USD/JPY down potential. Macro monetary driver for FX flows; meaningful but not final.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index remains below 99.00 as 10-year US yield steadies
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is holding losses after registering minor gains in the previous day and trading around 98.80 during the early European hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move: below-99 print indicates broad USD weakness — high direct relevance to FX pairs and cross-market flows.

FX.title: US Dollar: Treasury twist signals structural risks – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes the US Dollar remains under pressure as EUR/USD trades around 1.17 following the US Treasury’s expansion of its Liquidity Support Buyback Operations.
FX.reason: FX-native analysis linking US Treasury buyback operations to USD downside. Structural-dollar risk theme supports USD weakness across FX.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar stands firm near three-month high vs weak USD ahead of data
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair remains under some selling pressure for the third consecutive day and trades near a three-month low, just above mid-1.3700s during the first half of the European session on Friday.
FX.reason: USD/CAD selling pressure = CAD strength vs USD. Relevant for CAD flows and commodity-linked FX but more regional than systemic.

FX.title: British Pound holds gains against a weak US Dollar despite downbeat UK Retail Sales
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) trades firm against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, with the GBP/USD pair pushing against six-month highs in the 1.3660 area at the time of writing, on track for a 0.8% weekly rally.
FX.reason: GBP resilience vs weak USD despite poor retail data — reinforces a yield/PMI-driven sterling strength narrative within the USD-weak environment.

FX.title: United Kingdom flash Services PMI expands faster to 52.8 in August, beats 51.8 estimates
FX.summary: The United Kingdom (UK) S&P Global Composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) expanded surprisingly at a faster pace to 52.5 in August due to robust service sector activity. The Composite PMI was expected to arrive lower at 51.6 from 52.2 in July.
FX.reason: UK PMI beat supports sterling via growth differentiation and potential yield support — moderate FX relevance as a fundamental driver.

FX.title: Euro holds near three-month highs as Eurozone Flash PMIs beat expectations
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) is trading a few pips below 1.1700 against a depressed US Dollar (USD) on Friday, on track for a more than 1% weekly rally, and with the three-month high of 1.1710 at a short distance.
FX.reason: Euro PMIs beating estimates = macro support for EUR vs USD; reinforces EUR strength theme amid broad dollar softness.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Hits fresh high since June as bulls eye gains beyond 0.7150
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair regains positive traction following the previous day's dismal Aussie jobs data-led modest fall and climbs to a fresh high since early June during the first half of the European session.
FX.reason: AUD/USD technical/price-forecast piece: signals Aussie strength versus USD but is primarily a technical/price-call (lower relevance per rules).

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar: Extreme shorts face a high bar for further losses – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny sees a tension between aggressive Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) tightening expectations and increasingly stretched short positioning in the New Zealand Dollar (NZD).
FX.reason: NZD flow/positioning note: suggests limited scope for further NZD weakness and potential squeeze dynamics — relevant for EM/antipodean FX flows but not systemic.

FX.title: Citi Turns Negative on Dollar After Warning on US Buyback Risk
FX.reason: Major sell-side house shifting to dollar-negative view tied to US buyback/balance-sheet risks — high-impact cross-market signal that amplifies USD weakness narrative.

FX.title: Japan's historic yen intervention has ‘turbo-charged’ the carry trade
FX.summary: Japan's historic effort to prop up the yen may have had an unintended consequence: giving investors a better opportunity to put the carry trade back on.
FX.reason: Intervention-linked flow dynamics: suggests carry trade revival could weigh on JPY (and reshape cross-asset FX flows). Significant market-structure implication for USD/JPY and carry-sensitive pairs.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD hits highs past $69.00 amid US Dollar weakness
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) rallies for the third consecutive day on Friday, hitting fresh two-month highs above $69.00 in the early European session.
Commodities.reason: Precious metal rally driven by USD weakness and softer rate-hike expectations — bullish for silver prices. Technical/price-action piece but USD/Fed backdrop gives meaningful macro transmission.

Commodities.title: Gold climbs beyond $4,550, fresh high since June as USD stays weak and Fed hike bets fade
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its breakout momentum above a technically significant 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) and climbs further beyond $4,550, hitting a fresh high since early June during the early part of the European session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Gold rally tied to USD weakness and fading Fed-hike bets (lower real yields), a broad macro driver supporting precious metals — high relevance for commodities positioning.

Commodities.title: Gold Set for Third Weekly Gain on US Treasury Buyback Plans
Commodities.reason: Treasury buyback plans imply downward pressure on yields or term-premia, supportive for gold via lower opportunity cost — reinforces bullish precious-metals regime.

Commodities.title: Oil prices head for second weekly rise as U.S. vows to turn up economic pressure on Iran
Commodities.summary: Oil prices eased Friday but remained on track for a second straight weekly gain as hopes of a swift reopening of the Strait of Hormuz faded to near-zero.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical risk (US pressure on Iran, Strait of Hormuz disruption risk) is lifting oil risk premia and supporting prices — net bullish for crude in the near term.

Commodities.title: Oil Set for Weekly Surge as US Seeks to Throttle Iran’s Economy
Commodities.reason: Stronger geopolitical escalation risk to Iranian supply is a significant upward driver for oil — material market-moving theme raising oil risk premia.

Commodities.title: Iranian Oil Supply to Chinese Refiners Squeezed by US Blockade
Commodities.reason: Direct supply squeeze to a major buyer (China) tightens global crude balances — bullish for oil prices and consistent with the broader Iran-related risk premium.

Commodities.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
Commodities.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
Commodities.reason: Productivity gains and longer laterals raise US crude and gas supply — a structural negative for energy prices, offsetting some geopolitical upside.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: Record US gas production increases downside pressure on natural-gas prices and lowers upside from demand shocks — meaningful negative fundamental for gas.

Commodities.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
Commodities.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Sh
Commodities.reason: Higher inter-regional flows ease regional supply strains and act as a modest negative for crude price dispersion and local tightness — limited but relevant supply-side detail.

Commodities.title: SLB Prepares to Restart 15 Oil Rigs in Venezuela
Commodities.reason: Potential restart of Venezuelan rigs implies incremental supply upside if realized — bearish for oil prices, though delivery/timing and sanctions risk limit relevance.

Commodities.title: Corn Rally to Wednesday’s Final Bell
Commodities.reason: Short-term bullish price action in corn — relevant for agriculture commodity positioning and demand/supply attention in grains market.

Crypto.title: Live updates: BTC tops $76,000; bitcoin, ether ETFs pull in $800 million
Crypto.reason: Large ETF inflows and new highs are a clear bullish liquidity and demand signal for BTC/ETH — high-impact market-moving news for crypto.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin breaks out of six-week range, tops $71,000 as $3 billion in shorts get wiped out
Crypto.reason: Large short liquidations and breakout dynamics reinforce momentum and reduce bearish leverage — meaningful bullish technical/flow signal.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, August 19, 2026: Crypto prices rise after SEC announces proposed regulation
Crypto.reason: SEC proposed regulation (per article title) represents regulatory clarity that the market is treating as positive — supportive for institutional adoption and price.

Crypto.title: U.S. CFTC chief puts staff on notice to create crypto regulations if Clarity Act fails
Crypto.reason: CFTC signaling of regulatory backstop increases the chance of a clearer rulebook vs. regulatory vacuum — modestly positive for markets.

Crypto.title: BitGo secures South Korea virtual asset license, says it's the first global crypto company to do so
Crypto.reason: Geographic expansion and licensing for a major custody provider supports institutional access and adoption — positive but idiosyncratic.

Crypto.title: Elon Musk's X is exploring stablecoins to pay influencers and content providers
Crypto.reason: Potential large-scale payments use-case and adoption channel for stablecoins/crypto on a major platform — modestly positive for crypto rails and demand.

Crypto.title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
Crypto.reason: Security exploit and chain halt increase counterparty and protocol risk, weighing on altcoin sentiment and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s Short Squeeze Leaves Rally Hunting for Real Buyers
Crypto.reason: Analysis warning that rally is driven by squeezes rather than broad buyer conviction is a cautionary signal — modestly negative for sustainability.

Crypto.title: Treasury buybacks could set up bitcoin’s next move toward $180,000, says strategist
Crypto.reason: Macro liquidity thesis linking Treasury buybacks to risk asset flows provides a bullish fundamental channel for crypto — supportive but speculative.
